# Gurdwaar.com

> > A comprehensive global directory and spiritual resource platform connecting Sikhs to Gurdwaras (Sikh temples) worldwide, offering sacred texts, live temple radio, and daily spiritual guidance.

Gurdwaar.com serves as a centralized hub for the global Sikh community, providing access to Gurdwara listings across India and internationally, along with digital access to Gurbani (sacred scriptures) and real-time spiritual content from the Golden Temple in Amritsar. The platform combines community directory functionality with devotional resources including daily Hukamnama (divine guidance), Kirtan radio streaming, and downloadable religious texts in multiple formats.

## Key Topics

- Gurdwara Directory
- Guru Nanak
- Gurbani
- Sikh Temple

- Hukamnama

- Gurdwara Registration

## Core Resources & Directory

- [Gurdwara Sahib List of the World](https://gurdwaar.com/gurdwara): Global directory of Gurdwaras with listings of Sikh temples worldwide
- [Register Gurdwara](https://gurdwaar.com/gurdwararegister): Register new Gurdwaras to the global Gurdwaar.com directory

## Spiritual Content & Scriptures

- [Daily Hukamnama from Sri Harmandir Sahib - Golden Temple](https://gurdwaar.com/hukamnama): Daily Hukamnama spiritual guidance from Golden Temple Amritsar
- [Download Gurbani - PDF - MP3](https://gurdwaar.com/gurbani): Download Gurbani texts and prayers in PDF and MP3 formats
- [Gurdwara Radio](https://gurdwaar.com/gurdwara-radio): Live streaming radio from Harmandir Sahib Golden Temple with Kirtan
